title: S17 nicked nanoengine (nNE) mechanical driver - DNA origami leaf-spring nanoengine actuated by HT-T7RNAP transcription

source_pin.license: CC BY 4.0 (article + Nanobase structure files by documented inference)
source_pin.note: nNE.top byte-identical to 4 Zenodo members (linked.top in hinge23/hinge37/pull_release23/pull_release37 runs); verified in EX-PREP-S17-R2

nNE.index_space: 0-based particle index; .top body row i == particle i; strand ids 1-based contiguous in-file order; -1 = no n3/n5 neighbour

local_frame.note: no annotated local coordinate frame is published for nNE.top/nNE.dat; the mapping between the caDNAno design (NE_halo_dsDNA.json is a different, halo-tag design without D-F overhangs) and particle indices is not machine-readable

anchors.note: all pinned topologies carry placeholder sequences; the connecting ODN staple body cannot be localized to particle indices

orientation.note: 5'-terminal overhang per recipe offsets [25,45) at the 3' end of the ODN; physical arm/helix assignment readable only from the Suppl. Fig. 5a bitmap

mechanical_dofs.description: pulsating opening/closing of the two rigid origami arms against the dsDNA flat spring, driven by 16 pN transcription pull of HT-T7RNAP on the dsDNA-t (force anchors nNE: particle 8694 toward ref_particle 7374, stiff 0.329, r0 8.8 oxDNA units = 7.496 nm)
mechanical_dofs.evidence: article Fig. 2-3 and Methods; force pair SOURCE_CONFIRMED in EX-PREP-S17-R2 (polymerase_positioning.txt == Nanobase T7_force.txt for nNE)

compatible_conditions: oxDNA2 nucleotide model; salt conditions of the published runs (see Zenodo input files pinned in the knowledge pack)
constant_trap force semantics: F pulls particle toward ref_particle to rest separation r0; stiff=0.3290; PBC=1
do not mix oxDNA reduced units with SI units without the explicit 0.8518 nm/length-unit factor

observables.name: inter_arm_angle_distribution
observables.definition: angle between the two origami arms measured from TEM 2D class averages (published: median 67 no-transcription / 41-75 transcription; Fig. 6f,g for D-F)
observables.note: smFRET/TEM observables defined in publication; E5-style MD observables are NOT_EVALUATED and require the frozen NL6 protocol path

actuation.mechanism: HT-T7RNAP transcription of dsDNA-t pulls the arms together against the leaf spring (chemical fuel: NTPs)
actuation.note: actuation inputs are documented for provenance only; R3 performs no MD runs

unverified_fields: connection capability of all D-F ports (blocked by UNKNOWN anchors)
known_limitations: pinned topologies carry placeholder sequences: nucleotide-index anchors of the 10 D-F overhangs are UNKNOWN
the caDNAno design surface available on Nanobase (NE_halo_dsDNA.json) is a halo-tag design that does NOT contain the D-F connecting ODNs
this spec documents the driver as published; it is not a claim of motion transfer, of engine efficiency, or of fabricability
NE/NE_NB/soft design families exist as separate namespaces and are intentionally not mixed into this spec

provenance.source_registry: S17-LEAF-SPRING-NANOENGINE-R1_R2 (docs/research/S17_KNOWLEDGEPACK_R2.json); no second provenance registry introduced
